newsitem.title: USA: Viatel signs on with FLAG group.
newsitem.headline: Viatel signs on with FLAG group.

text.p: Viatel Inc said Friday it has joined AT&T Corp, British Telecommmunications Plc, MCI Communications Corp, NYNEX Corp and others as a signatory to the Fiberoptic Link Around the Globe (FLAG) agreement.

Viatel said FLAG will provide it with added bandwidth capacity on FLAG's transoceanic, intercontinental fiber system, currently under construction. It will also give Viatel interconnections to its system in three of the seven European countries where Viatel operates, including the UK, where its major switching center is located.

When completed in 1997, FLAG links will extend from the UK to Japan, connecting three continents and 12 countries, and will be the longest-ever undersea fiberoptic cable, extending more than 27,000 kilometers and providing 120,000 64 kilobit per second digital circuits along its route.
"Our participation as a FLAG partner and ownership of fiber facilities furthers our objective of migrating customer traffic from leased to owned lines," said Michael J. Mahoney, president of Viatel.
